T2.verdict: FAIL: 33.7 s process CPU against a 5,000 ms budget. The scan cost is dominated by full scans of 820,040 relationship rows that read each row's evidence metadata (json_extract on metadata, confidence, source/target) and by the file-level GROUP BY join; the fix requires covering/expression indexes on the relationship table (schema/index scope), not another SQL rewrite in this lane.

schemaFix.verdict: Still over the 5,000 ms budget: p50 9,343 ms / p95 10,321 ms wall at 8.1-10.6 s process CPU, down from 33.7 s CPU (3.6x). Reads left db+WAL unchanged. Remaining cost from the final statement profile (raw/t2-profile-postfix.json, 13.2 s): DISTINCT target_external over clean rows 4.58 s (target_external is NOT in the covering index, so each row still touches the relationship heap), symbol rows for the 52,903 reported-type symbols 3.20 s, used/incoming aggregate 1.30 s, referenced-file join 1.03 s, file coverage aggregate 0.96 s, long-parameter rule 0.60 s. A second covering index that includes target_external (and, for the symbol scan, a narrow (project_id, symbol_type) covering index over the columns the scan reads) would address the two largest lines; both are schema/index changes, outside this tool's write set.
